ModMetaData.name: Prisoner Arena (Continued) - Upgraded
ModMetaData.author: celphcs30
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/buuPQel.png[/img]
[h1]Satisfy your barbarian needs![/h1]
Arrange fights between your prisoners, slaves, animals, mechs, and mutants. Spectators gain joy from watching the matches!
[h1]Features[/h1] [list] [*] Fights can go until death or until one fighter is downed [*] Scoreboard saves the names of all winners [*] Winners can be rewarded with freedom or glory [*] Spectators stand outside the fighting area to enable construction of fences around fighters [*] Animals, slaves, mechs and mutants can be selected as fighters [*] Configurable arena radius and spectator buffer zones [*] Support for both square and circular arena shapes [*] Fighters automatically equip any weapon within arena radius [/list]
[h1]How does it work[/h1] You select two prisoners and start the fight from the arena spot menu. Any pawn capable of wardening will haul the fighters into the fighting area.
[list] [*] Fighters can be prisoners, colonists, slaves, animals, mechs, or mutants [*] Only undrafted pawns can haul fighters to the arena (drafted pawns don't take work giver jobs) [*] If all potential haulers are drafted, the fight won't start until someone is undrafted [*] Fighters cannot haul themselves - other pawns must do the hauling [/list]
Build it from Misc - Arena Spot
Should be compatible with practically anything. Safe to add to existing colony. Before removing the mod make sure you don't have any arena spots on your map and your prisoners aren't fighting.
[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1] This version includes critical performance fixes: [list] [*] Fixed game lockup when selecting Arena Spot buildings [*] Implemented caching system for overlay calculations (only recalculates when settings change) [*] Optimized cell lookups using HashSet for O(1) complexity instead of O(n) [*] Eliminated per-frame memory allocations [*] Fixed crash/freeze when selecting colonists as fighters (null reference exceptions) [*] Fixed save/load bug where both fighters used the same save key [*] Fixed game freeze when scheduling fights with colonists (work giver trying to assign haul jobs to fighters) [/list]
[h1]Credits & History[/h1] [list] [*] Original mod by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1668624708]Gl0b[/url] [*] Continued by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2022581505]Mlie (emipa606)[/url] - [url=https://github.com/emipa606/PrisonerArena]GitHub[/url] [*] Performance fixes and RimWorld 1.6 update by celphcs30 [*] Russian translation by Amycolis [*] Animal fighter support by Gagaro and jeonggihun [/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PwoNOj4.png[/img]
[h1]Support & Bug Reports[/h1] [list] [*] See if the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active [*] If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again [*] Post your error-log using [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=818773962]HugsLib[/url] or the standalone [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Uploader[/url] and command Ctrl+F12 [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting [*] Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that [*] If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the GitHub repository [*] Use [url=https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/releases/latest]RimSort[/url] to sort your mods [/list]
